description: Make or release text wrap on objects (Object > Text Wrap > Make, Release, Text Wrap Options): text in frames below the object flows around it, at an offset, or inside it with invert. The object must be above the text

invert.description: Invert Wrap: flow the text inside the object

offset.description: Offset in points between the object and the text

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

wrap.description: true: Make; false: Release. Default true

name: set_text_wrap
title: Set Text Wrap
